metadata.title: ABIDE-II fMRIPrep Derivatives: A Site-wise Preprocessed Neuroimaging Dataset
metadata.description:
Overview

This dataset contains fMRIPrep-derived neuroimaging data generated from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (ABIDE-II) dataset. The derivatives are organized by acquisition site and distributed as separate site-level archives to facilitate selective downloading and reuse.

The source data were obtained from ABIDE-II, a multi-site neuroimaging resource for autism spectrum disorder research. According to the ABIDE-II documentation, the source datasets were anonymized in accordance with HIPAA guidelines and the 1000 Functional Connectomes Project / International Neuroimaging Data-sharing Initiative (INDI) protocols.

This dataset is an independently generated derivative release and is not an official ABIDE-II distribution.

Preprocessing

Neuroimaging preprocessing was performed using:

  • fMRIPrep version: <25.2.5>

  • Container/runtime: <Docker>

  • Template/output spaces: <MNI152NLin6Asym>

The exact preprocessing command and additional provenance information are provided with this dataset.

Dataset organization

The dataset is distributed as separate archives for individual ABIDE-II acquisition sites. This organization allows users to download only the sites required for their analyses instead of downloading the complete dataset.

Each site archive contains the corresponding fMRIPrep derivatives while preserving the fMRIPrep/BIDS-Derivatives directory organization as much as possible.

A manifest and SHA-256 checksums are provided to facilitate subject identification, file verification, and reproducibility.

Source dataset

The derivatives were generated from data made available through the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (ABIDE-II).

Users of these derivatives should cite the original ABIDE-II publication and comply with the applicable ABIDE / 1000 Functional Connectomes Project / INDI data-use terms.

Citation

When using this dataset, please cite both:

  1. This Zenodo dataset and its DOI.

  2. The original ABIDE-II publication:

Di Martino, A., O'Connor, D., Chen, B., et al. (2017). Enhancing studies of the connectome in autism using the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II. Scientific Data, 4, 170010. DOI: 10.1038/sdata.2017.10.

Disclaimer

This is an independently processed derivative dataset. It is not produced, maintained, or endorsed as an official ABIDE-II release by the ABIDE consortium.
